Submitted (ok:true).

**What changed:** the proposal is now an append-only `insert_after` on p0009 rather than a replace of the whole final sentence, which cleared both official minimality gates (word-expansion ratio and 0.600 changed-character ratio) without touching a single existing word.

**Level switch:** preferred could not pass the official checks — the paid-up perpetual/irrevocable limbs have no condition in this clause (Section 1.4 grants term-based hosting access, not a paid-up licence), and a locked `deviation` finding may not carry unaddressed elements. I therefore switched the whole proposal to the complete fallback: affiliate coverage on written notice to HDI plus transfer to a successor in an M&A transaction. Consistent with fallback scope, contractors and the irrevocability/uncured-breach language were dropped rather than left as a hybrid.
